reason: Executable stdio MCP entrypoint registers seven real GA4 Admin/Data tools, two adjacent web APIs and two local inspection tools.

tools.name: get_account_summaries
tools.description: Lists every GA4 account and its properties for the credentials in use. Admin API, no GA4 tokens. Call it once per session to find a property ID, then work on that one property.
tools.behavior: Lists accounts and property summaries; projects account, displayName, property name/displayName/type; cached metadata.

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Returns details (display name, time zone, currency, industry, create time) for one GA4 property. Admin API, no GA4 tokens; cached 6h.
tools.behavior: Reads property details and selects name, displayName, timeZone, currencyCode, industryCategory, propertyType, createTime and parent; cached metadata.

tools.name: list_google_ads_links
tools.description: Lists the Google Ads accounts linked to a GA4 property. Admin API, no GA4 tokens; cached 6h.
tools.behavior: Lists links under properties/{propertyId}; returns name, customerId, canManageClients and createTime; cached metadata.

tools.name: run_report
tools.description: Runs a GA4 core report: dimensions x metrics over a date range. Pool: core. Cost grows with rows, dimensions, date range and cardinality, so use orderBys, a small limit and a dimensionFilter.

startDate.description: e.g. 7daysAgo, 28daysAgo, today, or YYYY-MM-DD. Range max 93 days.

limit.description: Rows to return. Max 50 with a high-cardinality dimension.

metric.description: Metric name to sort by, e.g. "totalAdRevenue"

dimension.description: Dimension name to sort by instead of a metric

orderBys.description: Sort rows server-side, e.g. top pages by revenue. Required with pagePath, pageTitle, landingPage and custom dimensions.

dimensionFilter.description: Filter rows server-side instead of pulling them and filtering

tools.behavior: Builds one date range with named dimensions and metrics, limit/offset, metric or dimension sorting and ANDed string dimension filters. Requests property quota; returns compact headers/rows, rowCount, returned/truncated and quota, cached report. Money-like metric names trigger cached Admin getProperty lookup to append currencyCode.
notes: Implementation guards, not schema constraints: at most 4 dimensions, 6 metrics and 93 inclusive days when dates parse; pagePath/pageLocation/pageTitle, landingPage* and customEvent:/customUser: dimensions require nonempty orderBys and limit <=50. Validation occurs only on cache miss.
orderBys objects allow neither or both metric/dimension; handler prefers metric when truthy and otherwise forwards dimension, without enforcing exactly one.

tools.name: run_funnel_report
tools.description: Runs a GA4 funnel report: how many users completed each step of an ordered event sequence. Pool: funnel. Use few steps and the shortest date range; rows are capped at 100.

steps.description: Ordered funnel steps, each matched by a single eventName

tools.behavior: Builds an ordered funnel whose steps filter eventName with stringFilter.value; requests property quota. Compacts funnelTable dimension/metric headers and rows and caps returned rows to 100; cached report.
notes: 100-row cap is applied after API response; no request row limit or date-range guard. Event stringFilter lacks an explicit matchType.

tools.name: get_custom_dimensions_and_metrics
tools.description: Lists the custom dimensions and custom metrics defined on a GA4 property. Pool: core (getMetadata spends a few core tokens, no quota is returned). Cached 6h, so call it once.
tools.behavior: Reads properties/{propertyId}/metadata; filters dimensions and metrics to customDefinition and returns apiName, uiName and description; cached metadata.
notes: Despite description naming core pool, cachedCall has no pool field, so shared quota gate/record is not used; getMetadata returns no quota.

tools.name: run_realtime_report
tools.description: Runs a GA4 realtime report covering the last N minutes (max 30). Pool: realtime. Keep dimensions few and the limit small; results are cached 60s.
tools.behavior: Uses named dimensions and metrics and minuteRanges from minutesAgo to 0; requests property quota; compacts response with row counts and quota; cached realtime. Money-like metrics trigger cached Admin getProperty currency lookup.

tools.name: run_pagespeed_insights
tools.description: Runs a PageSpeed Insights audit for one URL (Lighthouse performance/SEO/accessibility/best-practices scores).
tools.behavior: GETs the PageSpeed endpoint with URL, strategy, repeated category parameters and PSI_API_KEY. Returns rounded Lighthouse category scores and display values for LCP, CLS, TBT and FCP; cached PSI.
notes: Tool is always registered; missing PSI_API_KEY returns an error result.

tools.name: request_indexing
tools.description: Notifies Google's Indexing API that a URL changed, so it can be recrawled sooner. Requires the GA service account to be added as an Owner of the URL's property in Search Console, otherwise this returns a 403 ownership error. Not cached (it's an action, not a query).
tools.behavior: Obtains scoped service-account auth and POSTs {url,type} to urlNotifications:publish through the indexing rate limiter; returns response data or caught error plus ownership hint; no cache.
notes: Uses the same GA4 service-account credentials with indexing scope; ownership errors become normal text error results.

tools.name: get_cache_status
tools.description: Lists every cached tool response on disk: which tool, params, age, TTL, and whether it's still fresh.
tools.behavior: Reads on-disk cache JSON entries, consulting memory when available, and returns toolName, params, ageSeconds, ttlSeconds and freshness; creates cache directory if absent.
notes: Malformed on-disk cache JSON is not caught by status().

tools.name: get_rate_limit_status
tools.description: Shows GA4 quota left per property and pool (from the shared ledger the dashboard also writes), the reserve thresholds, Google's limits and the local throttle state. Costs no GA4 tokens.
tools.behavior: Returns shared ledger project identifier, cooldowns, quota entries, next daily reset, reserve thresholds and standard limits, plus refreshed local token bucket state; no Google calls.

notes: Source review only; no tools/list, upstream execution or live requests. Source has no .git; supplied revision is authoritative.

All 11 tools register unconditionally; package.json mcp script launches mcp-server/index.js and dependencies include SDK, Zod and GA client libraries. GA clients initialize lazily and require GA4_CLIENT_EMAIL and GA4_PRIVATE_KEY from root .env.

Zod shapes reconstructed as JSON Schema; defaulted parameters are optional inputs. Zod objects strip unknown keys, represented by additionalProperties false. No exposed numeric-ID regex or date-format restriction beyond descriptions.

cachedCall checks disk/memory cache before guards, then limits property spread (default 3 properties/10 minutes), concurrency (default 3/property), pool quota and cooldowns, and local API-family throttling. Report/realtime/funnel record quota in shared ledger. TTL defaults: metadata 21600s, report 3600s, realtime 60s, PSI 1800s, configurable by environment.
Every output uses compact JSON text; guard.fitResult removes trailing report rows for default 12000-byte cap. Non-row responses can exceed this cap. API read tools also write local cache/ledger.
rateLimit permits one retry for unavailable/server errors and concurrency exhaustion; PSI 429 is mapped to code 8 and retried once. No definite entrypoint blocker identified by source inspection.

review.method: Independently reconstructed and compared all eight parameterized Zod schemas/descriptions; directly checked the other three no-input registrations and descriptions. Read native report/funnel/realtime callbacks, compact result limits, cache/quota guards and separate PageSpeed/indexing handlers. The dashboard app is not counted as another MCP.
